$comment: The Powerhouse package manifest, as ph-reactor consumes it. Fields the
daemon adds itself are absent here on purpose: publisher_key is the
identity of the node that signs the package, sig is made over the whole
thing, and bundle is the content hash of the built editor. None of the
three can be asserted by the author -- they are facts about the publish.
documentModels is a list of FILES here; the publish script inlines their
definitions, because a manifest that referenced a model fetched elsewhere
would be a hole in exactly the provenance the signature exists to give.
name: @powerhousedao/achra
description: A marketplace for global coordination: objectives published, proposals signed, agreements kept.
